research_subject.geography_filter: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu; uPVC windows, doors, profiles and hardware

data.executive_summary: The strongest partnership evidence is a cluster of Luftung-owned/controlled Instagram posts and Facebook copy explicitly calling Eshanya Trade Links its authorised channel partner for Tamil Nadu, plus a separate Coimbatore-focused Instagram account post saying LUFTUNG × ESHANYA TRADE LINKS. Eshanya's IndiaMART profile is under the different seller slug sri-taksh-enterprises and lists Coimbatore uPVC profiles. A Vitharn landing page supplies the clearest Eshanya NAP. No Eshanya-specific Justdial listing, Google Business profile/citation, news article, or Eshanya-specific TradeIndia seller page was found in the accessible/indexed results; do not conflate unrelated Justdial/TradeIndia businesses.
